name: Al-Khwarazmi
biography: Ninth-century Persian mathematician and astronomer who transmitted Sanskrit/Indian astronomical and numerical learning; his book, translated into Latin as 'Algoritmi de numero Indorum,' gave the West so-called 'Arabic' numerals, and his algebra text was used in the West until the sixteenth century.
